sources.read_evidence: Read the full HTML section, including the proof of Lemma 13.28.2: the inverse is the finite alternating cohomology class, additivity comes from the long exact sequence, and stupid truncations give surjectivity. Lemmas 13.28.3–13.28.6 state functorial and related extensions, with some proofs explicitly omitted by Stacks; local scaffold strategies fill the used arguments.
